license_notes: Annotations: GiantSteps project (github.com/GiantSteps/giantsteps-tempo-dataset); annotations_v2 are the Schreiber & Mueller 2018 crowdsourced values. Audio: Beatport 2-minute preview mp3s (never redistributed); primary fetch is JKU's backup mirror per the upstream audio_dl.sh v0.3 (2025-03).

sources.name: annotations
sources.notes: annotations_v2/tempo/<id>.LOFI.bpm = single crowdsourced BPM (the eval standard; v1 kept in provenance); annotations_v2/mirex/ carries the two-tempo+salience form we do not score. md5/<id>.LOFI.md5 is the track list + per-file audio pin.

sources.name: audio
sources.notes: Same refetched_mismatch policy as giantsteps_key; kept as mp3 (tempo Acc1/2 is timing-insensitive).

notes: Tracks whose annotations_v2 value is 0.0 (unusable per Schreiber) are skipped at prep and counted; VERIFY the exact count at first prep run.
